results.title: Hegseth allows National Guard to boost DC patrols with military vehicles, boats and patrol cars
results.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has signed off on the National Guard ramping up its presence in the nation's capital in military vehicles and boats as troops deepen their integration with local law enforcement.
